_what: The SITE-PRIVACY PROCESS — owner-directed (2026-08-30): the observing site (a home address at 11 cm precision) moves out of every tracked file into a GITIGNORED config the chain reads as a reference, and a guard keeps it out. This record carries the census before and after, the scrub's per-file assertions, the guard's selftest, the regenerated records' field diffs and the premises not tested. The process: scripts/setup/site.example.json (tracked template, null values) -> scripts/setup/site.local.json (gitignored, rig-local; sessions/<session>/site.local.json session-local, precedence) -> scripts/lib/acquisition.py load_site_config() / site_coordinates() (the ONE loader; every consumer goes through it) -> acquisition.json `site` = PROVENANCE ONLY (resolved_from, config_sha256, status, verified, siteelev_recorded — no coordinate in any form) -> scripts/qa/check_site_privacy.py (guard + selftest in run_guards and the pre-push hook) RED on any form of the value in the tree or the index.
owner_directive_verbatim: add a solid process where the user can add the information to a config file that is gitignored and used as a reference instead of hardcoding the values
supersedes: the 2026-08-16 'untrack the site' denial — BACKLOG:`site-privacy-vs-public-repo` (the director records the ruling there); a history rewrite and the push stay the owner's decisions

note_refresh.new: `mount` is the one acquisition fact EXIF cannot record: declared by a human or derived from the measured drift signature — `mount_source` says which; `exif` is auto-derived by scripts/lib/acquisition.py — do not hand-edit it. `site` is PROVENANCE ONLY — resolved from the gitignored scripts/setup/site.local.json (or a session-local sessions/<session>/site.local.json), carrying that config's sha256 and status and NO coordinate; the numbers live in the config alone.
